title: Coordinate projection of Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $Ω$ be a finite nonempty set with probability measure $π$, and let $ι$ be a finite nonempty index set. Suppose $B$ is a basis of real-valued functions on $Ω$ that is orthonormal for the $π$-weighted inner product and has a distinguished index $0_B$ whose basis function is constantly one. For any $n\ge 0$, coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, function $f:Ω^n\to\mathbb R$, and multi-index $a\inι^n$, the Fourier coefficient of the function obtained by averaging $f$ over all coordinates other than $i$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $a$ if $a_i=0_B$, and is zero otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: Finite nonempty basis index set $ι$ with decidable equality
